title: Resident Services Desk Guidance: The Final Electricity Overage Line on the All-Inclusive Utility Package
content:
# The Final Electricity Overage Line — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**The line.** The final electricity overage line is the electricity overage line of the final billing period of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account whose billing responsibility has ended. It is issued at the first bill issue after the service end date and is owed from that bill issue day until it stands on the account whenever the final electricity overage is above zero. It rests on the actual service-end electricity read.

**Proration of the allowance.** The final electricity allowance is not prorated until the final period's package fee line stands on the account with its proration days. While the account's records do not yet show that line with its proration days, the final electricity allowance is not prorated.

**Effect.** Once posted, the line appears among the account's bill lines and the account's outstanding utility balance rises by its amount.

## Posting the line: `post_final_electric_overage_b496acda`

The resident services agent unlocks `post_final_electric_overage_b496acda` and calls it on the account in final billing. One call records one new electricity overage line dated today, resting on the actual service-end read, carrying the kilowatt-hours billed above the allowance and the amount billed, and raises the account's outstanding utility balance by that amount. The tool computes nothing and checks no condition.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `utility_account_id` | the reference number of the resident's utility services account in final billing, as returned by the utility account lookup | identifier |
| `billing_period` | the final service month the overage line bills | `YYYY-MM` |
| `usage_quantity` | the electricity usage above the final allowance, in kilowatt-hours | decimal with up to 3 places; recorded rounded to 3 decimal places |
| `amount` | the overage charge billed, in US dollars | 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; zero or positive |

### Receipt

The tool returns `status` (the string "posted"), `bill_id` (the reference number of the new electricity overage line), `billing_period` (`YYYY-MM`), `usage_quantity` (the kilowatt-hours billed above the allowance, 3 decimal places), `amount` (2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (the account's outstanding utility balance after the line, 2 decimal places).
